concept.niche: New School Year / Reading Teachers / Librarians
concept.concept: Mug reading 'Shh... I'm Plotting' with a small open book graphic, targeting librarians who love mystery and dark humor about their quiet authority.
concept.audience: School and public librarians, reading specialists, book club leaders
concept.rationale: Librarian identity merchandise is a passionate and underserved niche relative to teacher merch. The 'plotting' pun works on two levels (plot of a story, plotting something devious) which is exactly the layered humor this audience appreciates. Back-to-school timing drives gifting from colleagues and patrons. Mug is the ideal format. Phrase is original and avoids IP. Strong evergreen potential well beyond the season.

design.image_prompt: Flat vector illustration of an open book with pages slightly lifted, centered composition. Inside the book pages, a single eye peering out with a mischievous expression. Solid color blocks: deep navy blue, cream white, charcoal black, and burnt orange. No gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Bold simple shapes with clean sharp edges, screen-print aesthetic. Plain solid cream background with generous margin. Design readable at 12x16 inches from across a room.
design.style: Bold retro sans-serif, all caps, arched above the book illustration in charcoal black, maximum 6 words

verdict.reason: The phrase 'Shh... I'm Plotting' is a common generic humorous expression playing on the double meaning of 'plotting' (scheming vs. plot of a story) combined with the librarian 'shh' stereotype. No known trademark claims on this phrase, no celebrity or brand references, no protected characters or lyrics. The open book graphic is a generic clipart-style element. This type of wordplay-based occupational humor is widely considered in the public domain of common expression and poses minimal IP risk.

image_verdict.reason: Clean, original illustration of an open book with a stylized eye/head peeking over it. Generic mystical/reading motif with no IP concerns, no text, clean lines, solid flat colors, and no quality issues. Suitable for garment printing.

listing.title: Shh I'm Plotting Mug | Librarian & Reading Teacher Gift
listing.description: Perfect for librarians who know that plotting happens in the quiet corners of the stacks. This mug celebrates the wit and intelligence of reading professionals who maintain order through authority and dark humor. Features a charming open book graphic paired with mysterious lettering. Ideal gift for school librarians, public librarians, reading specialists, and book club leaders. Great for back-to-school season, librarian appreciation day, or any book lover on your list. Durable ceramic, dishwasher safe, holds 11oz.
